description: Lints a Fedwire or CHIPS ISO 20022 PostalAddress24 block against the Fedwire structured-address rules (network param selects fedwire or chips; rules verified byte-identical between the two networks at build time). The removal of the fully-unstructured postal address option, formerly set for 16 Nov 2026, was rescheduled to the November 2027 release (FRFS, 27 Aug 2026); exact date to be announced; until then Fedwire accepts unstructured and structured addresses; CHIPS is undated, aligned to the Fedwire cycle, TBC. The target format is unchanged: a single hybrid format -- Town Name and Country always required, up to 2 supplemental AdrLine elements of 70 chars each. Detects unstructured AdrLine-only addresses, hybrid silent-fail duplication (AdrLine echoing structured field values, which causes STP rejection without a visible error code), and address structure type (FULLY_STRUCTURED, HYBRID, UNSTRUCTURED, EMPTY). For the SWIFT CBPR+ cross-border equivalent use lint_cbpr_structured_address (art-241).
deadline_note: Fedwire structured-address removal rescheduled from the November 2026 release to the November 2027 release (FRFS, 27 Aug 2026); exact date to be announced; until then Fedwire accepts unstructured and structured addresses; CHIPS undated, aligned to the Fedwire cycle, TBC; no CHIPS date invented.

output.disambiguation: lint_fedwire_structured_address checks per-message Fedwire/CHIPS structured-address rule lint under the FRFS 27 August 2026 rescheduling (November 2027 release; exact date TBA; no day-precision deadline is published, so fedwire_chips_deadline is null and the status string carries the rule state; network param selects fedwire or chips; rules are byte-identical on both as of build-time verification, so one kernel covers both networks). For the SWIFT CBPR+ cross-border equivalent use lint_cbpr_structured_address (art-241).
output.fedwire_chips_deadline_status: Fedwire accepts unstructured and fully-structured addresses today; hybrid becomes supported with the November 2027 release (FRFS, 2026-08-27); exact date TBA; CHIPS undated (aligned-to-Fedwire cycle, TBC)
output.pii_note: All fields operate on STRUCTURAL address components only. No real party PII enters this kernel -- use synthetic or anonymised address data.
output.regulatory_basis: Federal Reserve Financial Services announcement of 27 August 2026 (Fedwire Funds Service November 2026 release rescheduled to the November 2027 release; unstructured and fully-structured addresses accepted until then, hybrid from the November 2027 release); The Clearing House CHIPS ISO 20022 implementation (aligned to Fedwire address rules; CHIPS cycle undated, TBC)
